title: Strix launches AI-powered hacker agents to test app security #Strix #AIpentesting #cybersecurity
description: Strix introduced a free, open-source AI pen-testing tool that simulates real hacker attacks on vibe-coded apps. It uses specialized AI agents to run live tests, identifying vulnerabilities, providing proof-of-exploit, and suggesting fixes before deployment. This approach goes beyond traditional vulnerability scans by actively demonstrating security gaps, which enhances developer confidence and accelerates secure app releases. Strix’s accessibility and automation empower smaller teams and individual creators to conduct thorough security assessments without costly resources. As cybersecurity threats increase, tools like Strix democratize protection and help maintain safer app ecosystems by catching and resolving risks early in development. #Strix #AIPenTesting #Cybersecurity #OpenSourceSecurity #VulnerabilityAssessment #AppSecurity #EthicalHacking #SecurityTesting #DevSecOps #TechInnovation #CybersecurityTools #SoftwareSecurity #AIinSecurity #HackSimulation #SecureDevelopment
